item.description: An aircraft has crashed south of Hurricane near the Utah-Arizona border, according to the Washington County Sheriff's Office (WCSO).

item.title: Utah leaders react after U.S., Israel launch major attack on Iran
item.description: Utah leaders are reacting on Saturday after the United States and Israel launched a major attack on Iran, an attack that President Donald Trump says killed Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Utah hosts first ever dog sled race in Uinta Mountains amidst snow shortage
item.description: Due to a serious lack of snow, Northwest sled dog races are facing cancellation, sending a rippling disappointment through the sled dog teams that look forward to these events each year.

item.title: Heber City holds 'tractorcade' demonstration to protest UDOT four-lane highway proposal
item.description: Hundreds gathered in Heber City on Saturday to protest a new four lane highway proposal introduced by the Utah Department of Transportation (UDOT).

item.title: Murray Library hosts America250 celebration with 'American Revolution show-and-tell'
item.description: The Salt Lake Valley Chapter of the Daughters of the American Revolution (NSDAR) kicked off its America250 exhibit with a show-and-tell featuring revolution-era documents on Saturday.

item.title: Hockey fans honor Utah Grizzlies last season in Utah by getting 'inked' to raise money for cancer warriors
item.description: The Utah Grizzlies partnered with the Ink Against Cancer Foundation for the final Ink Against Cancer Game & Live Tattoo Night to commemorate the team's final season in Utah and to raise money for cancer warriors.

item.title: Police search for suspect after shots fired at Rose Park gas station
item.description: A man is on the run after shots were fired at a Chevron gas station in the Rose Park area on Saturday evening.
